parameters.subject: =Your Contract for {{ $('Build Contract HTML').item.json.freelancer_service }} with the  {{ $('Build Contract HTML').item.json.client_name }} is Ready — Please Review
parameters.message:
={{ '

Your contract is ready for review

Hi ' + $(' Format Contract Data').first().json.freelancer_name + ',

Your AI-generated contract for ' + $(' Format Contract Data').first().json.client_name + ' is attached as a PDF.

Review the attached PDF carefully. You will receive a separate email asking you to Approve or Decline. The contract is only sent to your client after you approve.

' }}

parameters.subject: ={{ 'Approve contract for ' + $(' Format Contract Data').first().json.client_name + ' before it is sent?' }}
parameters.message:
={{ '

Review required

Hi ' + $(' Format Contract Data').first().json.freelancer_name + ',

Please review the contract PDF that was just emailed to you for ' + $(' Format Contract Data').first().json.client_name + ' (project: ' + $(' Format Contract Data').first().json.project_name + ', amount: ' + $(' Format Contract Data').first().json.amount + ').

Click Approve to send it to your client, or Decline to stop it.

' }}

parameters.subject: ={{ 'Freelance Contract — ' + $(' Format Contract Data').first().json.project_name }}
parameters.message:
={{ '

FREELANCE CONTRACT

' + $(' Format Contract Data').first().json.freelancer_service + '

Hi ' + $(' Format Contract Data').first().json.client_name + ',

Please find your freelance contract attached for ' + $(' Format Contract Data').first().json.freelancer_service + '.

Please review the attached PDF carefully. To accept this contract, simply reply to this email with the word AGREED.

If you have any questions before signing, feel free to reply to this email.

Best regards,

' + $(' Format Contract Data').first().json.freelancer_name + '

' }}
